text: Imani starts at the hospice Monday 3rd Nov, 8am sharp. She's nervous about the night shifts, first one is the Thursday after, and she's worried about leaving her son Duc with her mum overnight because her mum's not been great on her feet since the hip thing. Text her Sunday evening to wish her luck, and maybe offer to do the Thursday pickup.
tadhg's dad had a fall, hip op booked thurs morning. tadhg flying back to cork tomorrow at 6
Coffee w Wei. She got the senior designer role!! Starts 1st December. Her partner Hugo is retiring from the fire service in the spring, big do planned.

So I just got off the phone with Sean and um his little girl Ava has been in and out of hospital with her asthma again, they're back in on the 28th at half ten for a review with the consultant, and he sounded absolutely shattered. I should drop round with some food at the weekend, maybe Saturday afternoon.
Arturo leaving drinks Fri 7pm at the Crown. I'm doing the card.
Lena - knee surgery 12/11. Off work six weeks. Loves crime audiobooks, could send her a few credits.
Marcus mentioned his brother Milan got made redundant last week. Didn't want to talk about it much.
Joy's first day at the council went fine apparently, boss seems nice. Ask her how week two goes.
Need to call Camila back tomorrow morning about the spare room - her mum's coming over from Bogotá on 14 Nov for her chemo and they want somewhere near the hospital.
Abigail Nowak's retirement lunch got cancelled, she's got shingles. Poor thing. Send flowers.
Natasha (Tash) and Lachlan are both off to Lisbon 2nd–9th Jan. He finally got the promotion so it's a celebration trip.
chidi broke his wrist at 5 a side. cast for 6 wks. cant drive so I'm picking him up for work mon-wed
Cem says Emre's interview is Tuesday 4th at 2pm, final round at the bank. Emre is apparently bricking it. Message him Monday night.
Georgia's cat Biscuit had a lump removed this morning, all fine. She's working from home til Thursday to keep an eye on him.
Pick up prescription before 6, dentist Thurs 9:15.
Kieran is vegan now, and allergic to cashews. Note for the bbq.

Duc's mum is in hospital in Hanoi with pneumonia, he's flying out on the 22nd at 11pm. Doesn't know for how long, work have given him two weeks compassionate leave but he might need more. His sister Yuki (half Japanese, long story) is already out there. Must check in with him next week and offer to water his plants.
Andre got the head chef job at that new place on Kings Rd! Starts 3rd of March. Dinner there once he's settled.

Rang Kaito about the bike. Ended up talking for ages. His wife Yuki has had a bad back for weeks, can barely sit at her desk, so she's on physio Weds at 4 and then again the following Monday morning. He's doing the school run all week and his boss is being funny about him leaving early. Their dog Mochi keeps jumping on her which isn't helping.
Matteo's son Hugo starts reception in Sept. Matteo is more anxious than the kid lol.
Connor and his girlfriend are hosting a housewarming Sat 15th from 7. Bring wine, maybe a plant.
ahmed's last day at the warehouse is fri 31st. he's going to uni in jan to do nursing. chip in for the leaving present before thurs
Karan's dad has been diagnosed with Parkinson's. Karan's going part time from 1 Dec to help his mum look after him. He seemed ok but tired.
Owen mentioned he collects vintage Lego, mainly space sets. Birthday's 9th of Feb - good gift idea.
Dafydd's choir concert 6th Dec at 7.30, St Mary's. Get tickets for me and Imani.

Voice note. Okay so lunch with Lena today, she's had a rough few weeks, her dad, sorry, her uncle Owen, who basically raised her, had a minor stroke on the 2nd and he's in rehab now, and she's been driving up to Leeds every weekend. Also work want her to go full time from January which she doesn't want. Need to ring her Friday evening and see how the weekend went, and maybe offer to go up with her one Sunday.
Sean's promotion to team lead confirmed this morning. Review meeting was 9am today.
Wei's dog Pepper is going in for her teeth on 20/11. Wei's dreading it, Pepper hates the vet.
Moving the call with Marcus to tomorrow at 4. Also need to post his birthday present by the 25th.
Camila mentioned she's training for the Bath half in March. Runs with her sister Natasha on Sundays.
Arturo's wife Joy is expecting! Due early May. They haven't told her parents yet.
Milan started at the garage last Monday. Mechanic apprenticeship. Ask how the first month's going around the 10th.
Imani's kids both have chickenpox. She's off til Wednesday. Drop some Calpol and crisps round tomorrow morning.
Chidi: wants to retrain as a physio. Taking a course evenings from 13 Jan.
Emre (aka Mr Spreadsheet) got the bank job!!! Starts 2nd of Feb at 9. Send congrats, and drinks on him apparently.
Wedding at Georgia's sister's is off - they split in August. Georgia is gutted for her.

Talked to Kieran's partner Abigail at the school gate. Kieran's been signed off with stress since the 1st, his boss sounds awful. She asked me to not make a big deal of it. Maybe just invite him for a pint Thursday at 8.
Ring Duc Sunday 11am.
Remember: Andre's mum turns 70 on the 18th of December. Party at theirs the Saturday after, 3pm. He hinted she'd love a framed print of the old house.
Kaito's interview at Nintendo is next Friday at 10am London time (video call). He's really nervous. Don't forget to text him the night before.
Matteo Costa - new neighbour at no. 14. Works in insurance. Two boys, Hugo and Luca. Into cycling.
Connor's knee is still swollen after the match, scan at the Royal on 7 Nov at 3.40. Said he'd let me know.
Car MOT Thurs 13th at 8.30 - drop it off first thing and get the train in.

Ahmed called this evening, buzzing - his little brother Karan got into Edinburgh med school! Offer came through this morning at like 7am and the whole family were screaming apparently. Karan's been working at Tesco to save up and applied twice before, so this is massive. Ahmed's mum is throwing a little party Sunday 16th at 2. Card + something small, maybe a nice stethoscope?

Owen's moving to Bristol 1st of April with his new job, project manager at an engineering firm, big step up. His partner Andre is staying here till the summer to finish his teaching contract, so they'll be doing weekends for a bit, which Andre is not thrilled about. Will miss him. Leaving thing tbc, probably end of March.
Yuki's mum has been unwell, she flies to Osaka on the 3rd of Nov and back the 17th. Check in mid-trip.
Dafydd hates surprise parties. Do NOT organise one for his 40th.

Abigail Smith from work is retiring on 19 December after 32 years. Collection going round - put £20 in by the 12th. Her husband Lachlan is retiring too in March, they're doing a big trip to New Zealand in April.

Saw Natasha yesterday afternoon at the park. Her son's still off school with glandular fever, third week now, and the GP wants bloods done on the 11th at 9.20. She's juggling it all with the new job at the solicitors which only started on 6 October, so she can't really take time off yet. Her husband Cem works nights. She looked exhausted, honestly.
shopping: milk, bin bags, birthday card, batteries
Tadhg's band has a gig Sat 22/11 at 9pm, The Fleece. Going with Sean and Cem.
Lachlan Adeyemi (Lachie) asked to borrow the gazebo for his daughter's christening on the 30th. Drop it round the Friday before, after 6.
Spoke to Marcus. His mum's op went well this morning, she's home Thursday. He sounded so relieved. Follow up at the weekend to see how she's settling.
Booked physio for myself, Mon 10th at 7.45am. Then gym after work.

Camila's husband Arturo had a heart scare last night - in A&E til 3am, all tests clear so far but cardiology appt on 5th Dec at 11. She's not sleeping. I should check on her tomorrow lunchtime and maybe take the kids Saturday morning so she can rest.
Kaito didn't get the Nintendo job. Gutted but says he's ok. Keep an eye on him.
Joy's leaving the NHS after 20 years to go freelance. Last shift 28th of Feb. Bubbly order sorted, I'm bringing it to her do.
Milan's girlfriend Ava is a primary teacher, Year 2. She's gluten free.
Check Wei got the parcel I sent Tues. Tracking says delivered 2pm yesterday.
Georgia's grandad passed away Sunday night. Funeral Thurs 27th at 1pm, Swansea. Send a card today and ask if she needs a lift.
